faq_heading: Homes near Westerman Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Westerman Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Westerman Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Westerman Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Westerman Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 101 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,269,000, townhomes $695,000, condos $475,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Westerman Elementary?
faq.a: For the 101 homes that sold within 1 km of Westerman Elementary, the median time on the market was 33 days and the median sale was 96.6% of list; 11% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Westerman Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Strawberry Hill Elementary (0.4 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (0.7 km west) and Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south).

Westerman Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7626 122 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Westerman Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Westerman Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Westerman Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Westerman Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 101 homes sold within 1 km of Westerman Elementary: 28 houses, 21 townhomes and 49 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $475,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Westerman Elementary

33 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Westerman Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 8 secondary, 3 other; 6 independent). The closest is Strawberry Hill Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Surrey Muslim School, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Princess Margaret Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Strawberry Hill Elementary (0.4 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (0.7 km west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (1.3 km east), Kennedy Trail Elementary (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Strawberry Hill Elementary, 0.4 km east of Westerman Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Westerman Elementary was $475,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
